snippet.title: PSX Longplay [092] Rockman Complete Works: Rockman 2: Dr. Wily no Nazo
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played By: Tsunao

Mystery of Dr. Wily

The second game.  Another port released in Japan as part of a series called "Rockman Complete Works".

Follow Rockman as he commits robot-on-robot violence while pursuing the same evil scientist.  There's an intro, but it's in Japanese.  AUTOMATIC NO PLOT!

The more recognized Mega Man game and feels better than the first one.  I think it is the music.  Bastard difficulty is still present (lord help you if you run out of Bubble Lead for the final showdown.  Then again, it is kinda useless.)

For this run, I do the same:  play Navi mode (Roll is Navigator this time.), abuse rapid fire like a noob, abuse boss weakness like a noob, abuse the hell out of Metal Blade because it is overpowered, abuse Metal Blade + Rapid Fire, and just plain sucking!  Heat Man's stage, Item 2, Air Man, Leaf Shield, Wood Man, and E-Tanks may or may not be relevant.

No skills involved. -
